# PostgreSQL (`birme-osc-postgresql`)

Unlock the full potential of your data with the PostgreSQL OSC image, seamlessly integrated for use in Eyevinn Open Source Cloud. Experience robust scalability, high security, and unmatched extensibility.

[Source](https://github.com/birme/osc-postgresql)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "birme-osc-postgresql"
  name       = "mypostgresql"

  parameters = {
    # PostgresUser       = "..."
    # PostgresDb         = "..."
    # PostgresInitDbArgs = "..."
    # PostgresInitDbSql  = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    PostgresPassword = var.postgres_password
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PostgresPassword` | string | yes | Sets the password for the PostgreSQL superuser account. This is required to secure database access and authenticate connections. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `PostgresUser` | string | no | Specifies the username for the PostgreSQL superuser account. If not provided, defaults to 'postgres'. |
| `PostgresDb` | string | no | Sets the name of the default database to be created when the PostgreSQL container starts. If not specified, it will use the same name as the PostgreSQL user. |
| `PostgresInitDbArgs` | string | no | Provides additional command-line arguments to pass to the 'initdb' command during database cluster initialization. |
| `PostgresInitDbSql` | string | no | Specifies SQL commands or script content to execute during database initialization, allowing for custom database setup and configuration. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
